playwright.command: APP_ENV=test with isolated loopback database and explicit disposable-test opt-in; secrets omitted; pnpm exec playwright test tests/e2e/public-shell.spec.ts tests/e2e/public-link-integrity.spec.ts --project=chromium

database.isolation: fresh loopback PostgreSQL database habitat_brand_test, separate from development/preview/production
database.reset: both disposable databases dropped after verification

warnings: Playwright/WebServer emitted NO_COLOR ignored because FORCE_COLOR was set; no test or application failure resulted.

originalBlockedAttempt.cause: The destructive-test database guard refused to start without explicit disposable-database opt-in and matching test-only URLs.

implementation.typography: Supplied Neue Haas Grotesk Display/Text WOFF2 and supplied Minion Pro WOFF webfonts are registered through semantic roles.
implementation.colors: June 2025 palette is centralized in src/styles/tokens.css; public status and action text uses contrast-safe Traditional Blue where Bright Blue/Traditional Green fail AA as text.
implementation.logo: Controlled HabitatLogo uses official horizontal extended Fayette County black and white PNG assets without CSS recoloring or effects.
implementation.content: Static copy rules are implemented; no concrete banned public copy finding remains in the scaffold. Editorial tone, dignity, provenance, and consent remain human review.
implementation.imagery: No non-logo public photographic asset was present; no AI or fabricated replacement imagery was added.
implementation.restore: No ReStore route or content is present; ReStore checks are NOT APPLICABLE until a verified experience exists. May 2024 source remains required for future ReStore-specific conformance.

manualReview: Narrative quality, people-centered tone, dignity/respect, photography authenticity, provenance, consent, and local/DAN approval remain editorial review items.
Keyboard-only traversal, screen-reader reading order, 400% zoom/reflow, and reduced-motion human review remain required beyond automated axe/reflow checks.
Formal Minion Pro license provenance/documentation is pending delivery; supplied webfont assets are not included in evidence artifacts.
ReStore-specific rules beyond the June 2025 guide require the May 2024 ReStore Style Guide when a ReStore experience is implemented.
verificationNotes: The original build attempt was blocked by unavailable database access; the final build completed against habitat_brand_test after committed migrations and seed.
The original Playwright attempt was refused by the destructive-test database guard; the final focused suite ran against a fresh disposable database with the guard satisfied and not bypassed.

findingVerification.rationale: No non-logo public photographic asset exists in the implemented shell, so there is no image provenance, consent, dignity, or contextual-alt-text claim to approve yet.
findingVerification.evidence: final/imagery-audit.json reports an empty non-logo asset list.
findingVerification.futureApplicability: Becomes applicable when an approved non-logo image is added to public/ or a public route renders one.

findingVerification.rationale: No ReStore route, identifier, or public content is implemented in the current scaffold; the guide exception is not being exercised.
findingVerification.evidence: final/restore-audit.json reports no ReStore public route or content.
findingVerification.futureApplicability: Becomes applicable when a verified ReStore route, identifier, logo relationship, or public content is introduced; the May 2024 ReStore source must then be obtained for remaining rules.

findingVerification.affectedScope: named program or event identity in public source
findingVerification.rationale: No named program or event identity is present in the implemented public shell, so no separate lockup, ownership language, or mini-brand claim is being published.
findingVerification.evidence: final/program-event-audit.json reports no named program/event identity.
findingVerification.futureApplicability: Becomes applicable when verified program or event content is published in a public route or component.

findingVerification.rationale: This is the fourth final finding, but it is PASS rather than NOT APPLICABLE: static and rendered public-link checks completed with no reserved-host or destination failures.
findingVerification.evidence: final/link-audit.json reports 30 rendered links and 0 failures.
findingVerification.futureApplicability: A future invalid, stale, empty, fabricated, or otherwise ungoverned public destination would create a new failure finding.
